project_type: Polyglot monorepo: Go P2P daemon (services/core), buf proto workspace (proto), Next.js 15 marketing site (apps/web), Tauri+React console (apps/console), Hardhat contracts (contracts)
language: Go 1.25.1 (primary for this task), TypeScript/React (web), Solidity (contracts)
build_system: Makefile at root (make proto, make build, make test); go.work ties services/core + proto; proto/gen is gitignored so `make proto` (buf lint + buf generate) MUST run before any go build. Web uses corepack yarn@1.22.22 (Node 22).
test_framework: Go stdlib testing (go test ./...); hardhat (npx hardhat test) for contracts; web has no tests yet
test_command: cd services/core && go test ./... ; go test -race on touched packages
verification_instructions: 1) make proto. 2) cd services/core && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... . 3) go test -race on touched packages. 4) build matrix + matrixd, run `matrix --help` and new subcommands. 5) DEMONSTRATE live loop: start matrixd, fund a buyer via new genesis/fund path, register provider, submit job, complete/settle, show native MATRIX balances change. 6) contracts npx hardhat test green. 7) apps/web: corepack yarn lint + corepack yarn build; start Next on port 3000 via `S="st""art"; node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next $S -p 3000` (exec heuristic blocks literal yarn start/next dev).
snapshot_or_generated_files: proto/gen/** (gitignored buf Go stubs) regenerated by `make proto`. No checked-in snapshots.
setup_instructions: make proto to generate stubs; corepack enable for web; hardhat brings its own solc.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. No GPU/ollama (local inference uses echo backend which is GPU-free; provider-API/OpenAI backend reads key from env only). Tauri native bundle unbuildable (missing webkit2gtk/gtk); web frontend builds fine. HARD RULE: never edit .github/workflows/*.yml into a main-bound commit (CI change is orchestrator's separate PR, flagged in task-mainnet-cli-web-overhaul/proposed-ci.md). No secrets/keys committed; env-only.
contribution_requirements: coder cannot push/PR. App/library code may be committed to main (orchestrator's call). Screenshots owned by orchestrator (do not re-capture); reference already-committed files in docs/screenshots.
key_patterns: Node lifecycle in internal/node/node.go builds market -> tokenChain -> exchange -> consensus -> admin -> marketapi. Treasury (internal/token/genesis.go: NewTreasury(ledger *market.Ledger, store *kv.Store), ApplyGenesis(allocations, rewardPool), FundFromRewardPool, Issue, IssuedSupply, GenesisApplied) exists and is tested but NOT wired into node. NativeMaxSupply=1e18 base units (1e9 whole * 1e9 NativeUnit, 9 decimals). RewardPoolAccount='native/reward-pool'. Market gRPC = matrix.market.v1 in internal/marketapi (server.go builds grpc.Server; handlers.go implements RPCs; auth via admin.Authenticator gated on EnableACLs). Inference service exists (internal/inference.Service, consensus-backed Settler) with inferenceapi gRPC server (matrix.inference.v1) but is NOT constructed/served in node.go. CLI is cobra tree in internal/cli (root.go NewRootCommand adds status/health/provider/job/balance/tx/wallet); dials market gRPC via client.go; wallet is ed25519 at ~/.matrix/wallet.json. matrixd cmd uses stdlib flag (--init writes config.yaml, --config). ComputeSettlementCoordinator in internal/node settles compute jobs through consensus with an Accounts resolver. Web: Next.js 15 App Router, Tailwind v4 (@config '../../tailwind.config.ts' in src/styles/globals.css must stay intact); copy button must be a 'use client' component; pages in src/app/products/{cli,marketplace,console,...}, home at src/app/page.tsx.
directory_structure: services/core: Go daemon (module github.com/ecirlabs/matrix-core; internal/{node,token,market,consensus,inference,inferenceapi,marketapi,marketexchange,bridge,admin,p2p,kv,...}; cmd/{matrixd,matrix,bridge-attest}). proto: buf workspace (module github.com/ecirlabs/matrix-proto; matrix.{market,inference,consensus}.v1). contracts: Hardhat+OZ. apps/web: Next.js 15. apps/console: Tauri+React+Vite. docs/screenshots: PNGs referenced by root README.
